meta.name: modern_hellenist_siege
meta.prompt: A modern Hellenist city being invaded by sea monsters.

character.label: modern Hellenist metropolis under marine assault

programs.brief: A colossal multi-tentacled sea leviathan rising from the foaming ocean shallows, its massive dark prismarine and scaly horn carapace crashing over shattered concrete sea walls, with glowing sea lantern eyes and thrashing tentacles lunging toward the city waterfront.

A towering modern-neoclassical monument of Athena Promachos in smooth white quartz, chiseled calcite, and weathered copper trim, holding an elevated defensive aegis and energy spear pointed directly at the sea assault from a fortified coastal bastion.
An armored amphibious sea beast lunging from the surf, featuring spined prismarine ridges, tooth-rimmed jaws, and thrashing clawed appendages climbing onto the shore.

tokens.event_direction: sea monsters surging out of the coastal waters and attacking the city's waterfront promenade and harbour
tokens.terrain: a grand coastal metropolis with neoclassical boulevards, modern marble-and-glass civic plazas, and wide quays bordering deep sea
tokens.infra: barricade_line sealing the waterfront boulevards; emergency evacuation cordon across the harbour district; shore battery along the seawall
tokens.icons: colossal sea monsters emerging from the surf; modern monumental colonnades and propylaea; military vehicle checkpoints; smashed coastal piers
